title: Display
description: display (since 1.4): the node shows her somewhere else now, as the user chose. The server starts her turn about it (turn with the cause looking_glass_entered or looking_glass_exited). A node that shows her there as it starts (it remembered) does not send it.

lookingGlass.description: True when she is shown on a Looking Glass now, false when she is back in the node's window.
